title: A Good Friday Moment At the NORML Conference. Why I Do This.

content_html_sanitized:
Posted April 19, 2003

Yesterday afternoon, I walked up to new NORML Board Member, George Rohrbacher as he was talking to attorney Dale Schafer, whose wife, Molly Fry, M. D., is a cancer survivor and medical cannabis user and cannabis clinic operator.

Both are in the midst of pre-indictment negotiations with Federal prosecutors.

I arrived just in time to hear George tell Dale that he would raise their three children if Schafer and his wife were sent to prison.

Is arresting sick people and those who care for them Compassionate conservatism? Is it Christianity?

No.

It is Christ crucified.

And in your name.
